sentences.en: Last Saturday, I helped in a community event.
sentences.zh: 上周六，我参加了一个社区活动。

sentences.en: A group of us came together to clean the park.
sentences.zh: 我们一群人一起来清理公园。

sentences.en: Some people cut the grass and others picked up waste.
sentences.zh: 一些人割草，其他人捡垃圾。

sentences.en: I used a brush to clean the seats.
sentences.zh: 我用刷子清理座位。

sentences.en: The weather was good, so we did not have any trouble.
sentences.zh: 天气很好，所以我们没有任何麻烦。

sentences.en: After the work, a woman gave us cups of tea.
sentences.zh: 工作结束后，一位女士给了我们几杯茶。

sentences.en: The park looked much better than before.
sentences.zh: 公园看起来比以前好多了。

sentences.en: People said we did a great public service.
sentences.zh: 人们说我们做了一项很棒的公益服务。

sentences.en: I was tired but very happy.
sentences.zh: 我很累但是非常开心。

sentences.en: Helping the community is a good thing.
sentences.zh: 帮助社区是一件好事。

sentences.en: I will take part in more events in the future.
sentences.zh: 我以后会参加更多的活动。

sentences.en: A group of people working together can make a change.
sentences.zh: 一群人一起努力可以带来改变。

sentences.en: The event was a great success. Everyone was happy.
sentences.zh: 这次活动非常成功。每个人都很高兴。

sentences.en: People have a great respect for the workers.
sentences.zh: 人们对这些工人非常尊敬。

sentences.en: Each person was responsible for one part of the work.
sentences.zh: 每个人负责一部分工作。

sentences.en: It was a serious attempt to make the town better.
sentences.zh: 这是一次严肃的尝试，让城镇变得更好。

sentences.en: The park is public land, not private property.
sentences.zh: 公园是公共土地，不是私人财产。

sentences.en: The protest against the waste of public money was loud.
sentences.zh: 反对浪费公款的抗议声很大。

sentences.en: The police keep the rules and make the society safe.
sentences.zh: 警察维护规则，让社会安全。

sentences.en: The punishment for crime is decided by the law.
sentences.zh: 对犯罪的惩罚由法律决定。

sentences.en: The government made a decision to help the poor.
sentences.zh: 政府做了一个帮助穷人的决定。
